name: parle-bridge-shadow
description: parle: the audio bridge `conv` (Qwen3.5-9B Q4_K_M + the 1j conv mmproj, llama.cpp b11382 with the mel-trim patch) in SHADOW mode: it hears the same student audio as the real turn and its answer is only recorded, never heard or seen; one Vast RTX 3090 (then 4090), deleted after 10 min idle; PARKED (owner, 12/10/2026): not declared, no warm window; no cloud fallback on purpose (a missing shadow answer is recorded as such)

spec.bootScript:
set -eu
set -a; . /srv/aigw/app.env; set +a
apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git cmake build-essential curl ca-certificates
mkdir -p /srv/bridge && cd /srv/bridge
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 5 ${4:+-H "Authorization: Bearer $4"} -o "$2" "$1" && echo "$3  $2" | sha256sum -c -; }
CONV=https://huggingface.co/marcosremar2/qwen35-audio-bridge-pt/resolve/main/stage6-1j-conv
get "$CONV/mtmd-audio-trim-b11382.patch" trim.patch f4ec73311d98c9fc1aa60a7e290f97c36aeb9e059093be981a1bf54ebbc6e575 "$HF_TOKEN"
( get "$CONV/mmproj-s6-1j-conv-stack10-trim-mel-f16.gguf" conv.gguf 53116f4b41a68712a08fd7c10444b10e7c81b8449b7022630461514654c3f68d "$HF_TOKEN"
  get https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3.5-9B-GGUF/resolve/3885219b6810b007914f3a7950a8d1b469d598a5/Qwen3.5-9B-Q4_K_M.gguf llm.gguf \
    03b74727a860a56338e042c4420bb3f04b2fec5734175f4cb9fa853daf52b7e8 ) &
WEIGHTS=$!
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch b11382 https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp src && patch -d src -p1 < trim.patch
cmake -S src -B build -DGGML_CUDA=ON -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=native -DLLAMA_CURL=OFF -DLLAMA_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DLLAMA_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF
cmake --build build --target llama-server -j "$(nproc)"
wait $WEIGHTS
exec build/bin/llama-server --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 -m llm.gguf --mmproj conv.gguf --alias parle-bridge-conv \
  -ngl 999 -fa on --jinja --reasoning-budget 0 --cache-ram 0 -c 32768 --parallel 8
